title: Console GA prep: communication schedule & learning paths for Cost Transparency dashboard
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Objective: Coordinate cross-functional go-to-market (GTM) activities to launch the Cost Transparency dashboard to GA. This ticket captures the communication schedule, release notes coordination, enablement and training materials, internal support playbooks, and post-launch monitoring commitments.

Scope: feature set in GA includes per-token cost breakdowns, per-route routing cost estimates, token-level spend drilldowns, and an in-product guided tour. Excluded: dedicated customer billing exports (separate initiative).

Deliverables:
- Finalized release notes for public docs and Marketplace listing.
- Internal one-pager & support playbook with escalation matrix.
- Training curriculum: two instructor-led sessions + recorded demo + short walkthrough videos for support and solutions engineering.
- In-product tooltip copy and a 3-step in-console tour.
- Comms schedule with email cadence, blog post draft, and in-app banner messaging.
- Dashboard health checks and alerting (SLOs to be monitored for first 72 hours).

Owner responsibilities: PM (Jonah) will coordinate cross-team deadlines and sign-off. Design to own tooltip copy and recording; Eng to deliver feature flags and metric hooks; Docs to publish release notes; Growth to prepare customer-facing blog drafts and help center articles. Support to prepare canned responses and priority escalation paths.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Release notes (public + internal) approved by PM, Design, and Docs and published at least 48 hours before GA.
2) Training sessions scheduled and materials uploaded to the enablement folder.
3) In-console tour present behind 'cost_transparency' feature flag and validated in staging.
4) Alerting and dashboards for cost-related anomalies (token spend spike, batch size outliers) configured and tested.
5) Support playbook created with runbook steps and on-call contacts, and triage runbook rehearsed in a dry run.
6) At least one customer-facing comms asset (blog or announcement) ready for review.
7) Post-launch telemetry and success metrics tracked in the Console GA dashboard (DAU adoption, average tokens-per-session, queries with cost breakdown enabled).
training_plan: Week before GA: two 45-min instructor-led sessions for Support + SEs (UTC-friendly times), recorded video + 5-min product highlight clip. Office hours week-of-GA with Eng on-call for 3 days (4-hour daily window). Enablement checklist: slide deck, demo script, sample support responses, troubleshooting matrix, feature flag toggle guide.
comms_schedule: 2026-03-25: Internal product announcement + support playbook shared to #prod-support (PM)
2026-03-27: Release notes published and knowledge base article goes live (Docs)
2026-03-29: Customer-facing blog draft to Growth for review (Growth)
2026-03-31: In-app banner scheduled to run for GA day with link to docs (Eng + Console)
monitoring_and_rollout: Rollout strategy: dark-launch telemetry in staging -> 10% canary (feature flag) in prod for 24 hours -> 50% for 48 hours -> 100% if no critical alerts. Key metrics: time-to-first-cost-breakdown (ms), % sessions with cost breakdown enabled, anomaly rate (>3 sigma token spend). Alerting: Slack channel #console-prod-alerts and page if cost regression > 20% vs baseline. Post-GA 72-hour play: daily check-ins for metrics and support tickets with a triage meeting on day 3.

risks_and_mitigations: Risks: copy/UX not clear -> confusion & support load; metric hooks delayed -> inability to monitor. Mitigations: schedule final copy sign-off 72 hours before GA; if metric hooks slip, hold GA for specific subset and extend canary. Prepare fallback messaging and an FAQ for common billing questions.
success_metrics: Adoption: 30% of active console sessions view cost breakdown within first 14 days. Support: fewer than 10 high-severity billing tickets attributable to this feature in first 14 days. Quality: average token breakdown response latency < 200ms for 95th percentile. Comms: blog + release note click-through rate >= 8% among active workspace admins.
notes_for_followup: After GA: run a post-mortem in Cycle+1 if any P0/P1 support issues. Capture transcript from office hours and add common questions to the KB. Iterate tooltip text and tour steps based on heatmap and session replays.
